decision_rationale: This is an original evaluation/fine-tuning study of a genome language model on viral sequences, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. The evidence supports a biological sequence model only; no natural-language text component or text-bio bridge is shown.
evidence_snippet: "fine-tuning using sequences from 110 harmful human-infecting viruses"; "Fine-tuning was performed using the Evo 2-7B as a base"; "character-level tokenizer"
